faq.title: Questions before you start?
faq.description: Find quick answers about templates, booking pages, payments, trials and platform features.

coding-skills.question: Do I need coding skills to create my booking page?
coding-skills.answer: No. Start from a template, customize your services, branding and booking rules, then publish without coding.

reduce-no-shows.question: How does BookingBase help reduce no-shows?
reduce-no-shows.answer: Online deposits, confirmations and automated SMS or email reminders help reduce missed appointments.

download-app.question: Do customers need to download an app to book?
download-app.answer: No. Customers can book from your public page in any mobile, tablet or desktop browser.

multi-location.question: Can I manage multiple locations and staff shifts?
multi-location.answer: Yes. Manage locations, staff availability, service assignments and shifts from your dashboard.

custom-domain.question: Can I use my own custom domain?
custom-domain.answer: Yes. Selected plans let you publish your booking page under your own brand.

trial-card.question: Do I need a credit card for the 14-day trial?
trial-card.answer: No. Start the 14-day trial without a card and you will not be auto-charged.

after-trial.question: What happens after the 14-day trial?
after-trial.answer: Choose a paid plan, contact us for setup help, or let the trial end without an automatic charge.

feedback-rewards.question: What feedback may qualify for Early Access rewards?
feedback-rewards.answer: Workflow ideas, bug reports, integration requests and detailed booking notes may qualify.

rewards-guaranteed.question: Are Early Access rewards guaranteed?
rewards-guaranteed.answer: No. Rewards are reviewed case by case and are not guaranteed.

submit-feedback.question: Where can I submit feedback?
submit-feedback.answer: Email feedback@bookingbase.com or use the feedback link in the Early Access section.

cta.description: Reach our support team, or book a 15-minute walkthrough with a product specialist.
